purpose: Fix the comparator suite, validation regimes and reporting before any comparator result is examined, so that no model family, hyperparameter or evaluation regime can be chosen after seeing which is favourable.

shared_setup.label_preprocessing: as used by the frozen primary predictor; no additional transformation is introduced here
shared_setup.replicate_aggregation: one row per measured single-compound product, as curated
shared_setup.leakage_rules: identical to the frozen primary predictor; fold assignment happens before any featurisation

factorial_main_effects.definition: shrinkage model over amine, aldehyde and isocyanide identities
factorial_main_effects.implementation: ridge regression on one-hot component indicators
factorial_main_effects.unseen_levels: revert to the population prior; no coefficient is invented for an unseen component

factorial_pairwise.definition: main effects plus amine-aldehyde, amine-isocyanide and aldehyde-isocyanide interactions
factorial_pairwise.implementation: ridge regression on one-hot main effects and pairwise interaction indicators
factorial_pairwise.prohibited: any three-way term, which would memorise exact products
factorial_pairwise.purpose: strongest simple baseline; determines whether the neural model adds value beyond factorial component structure

nearest_analogue_product.definition: k-nearest-neighbour on whole-product Morgan fingerprints, radius 2, 2048 bits, Tanimoto

nearest_analogue_context_matched.definition: transfer from structurally similar measured aldehydes holding amine and isocyanide fixed where the factorial data permit; falls back to the product kNN when no context match exists
nearest_analogue_context_matched.note: both nearest-analogue variants are frozen here; neither may be dropped after seeing which performs better

fingerprint_nonlinear.definition: one prespecified nonlinear model on Morgan fingerprints concatenated with a small frozen RDKit descriptor set
fingerprint_nonlinear.implementation: ExtraTreesRegressor, chosen before viewing any prospective outcome

graph_neural_baseline.definition: supervised graph neural network ensemble on product graphs
graph_neural_baseline.naming: labelled a supervised GNN baseline, NOT an AGILE reproduction, unless the architecture, pretraining corpus and implementation can be represented faithfully; every deviation is documented

frozen_primary_predictor.note: The current predictor is not retrained, retuned or re-selected as part of this package.

validation_regimes.hyperparameter_rule: chosen using only the measured 1,100-product dataset; the identities, scores and eventual outcomes of the locked 30 are never used to choose model families or settings
validation_regimes.nested_cv: used wherever tuning would otherwise touch an evaluation fold

Q_aligned_combination_holdout.definition: hold out exact products while every component identity in the held-out product remains represented in training
Q_aligned_combination_holdout.evaluates: can the predictor rank new combinations of measured components

aldehyde_leave_one_component_out.definition: hold out an entire aldehyde identity, train without it, predict all products containing it
aldehyde_leave_one_component_out.reporting: performance as a function of similarity between the held-out aldehyde and the nearest training aldehyde
aldehyde_leave_one_component_out.status: diagnostic for analog transfer; NOT an eligibility gate for the N cohort

original_frozen_split.definition: the evaluation split originally used to develop and select the frozen primary predictor
original_frozen_split.prohibited: replacing it after seeing which regime is favourable

metrics: MAE and RMSE on the transformed and untransformed scales used in the project
calibration or interval coverage, only for models that natively produce uncertainty
performance by held-out component and similarity range

reporting_rules.no_post_hoc_winner: the entire frozen comparator set is reported; no winning baseline is selected after the fact
reporting_rules.panel_is_not_a_tournament: the 30 candidates were selected using the frozen current predictor, so the panel is not an unbiased contest among comparators. A comparator assigning different scores to the 19 Q candidates does not show it would have selected a better panel.
model_specific_claim_requires_both: superior or complementary performance in matched out-of-fold evaluation
prospective enrichment from the frozen Q-high versus Q-low allocation
reporting_rules.honest_null: if the factorial or nearest-analogue baseline performs comparably, that is reported. The prospective allocation result stands; the neural-model-specific advantage narrows.
reporting_rules.prohibited_analysis: a multivariable regression of current score plus all baselines on 19 Q candidates; it would be unstable. Any incremental analysis is low-dimensional, prespecified and secondary.

after_hyperparameters_are_fixed: refit every comparator on all eligible measured data
predict the complete corrected Q-eligible pool of 2,407 where computationally feasible
preserve raw means, native uncertainty where it exists, and all declared ranking scores
save panel ranks and full-pool ranks
prospective_freeze.hard_constraint: comparator predictions must not alter candidate identities or cohort assignments

nonclaims: A comparator scoring the panel differently is not evidence it would have chosen better.
Out-of-fold performance on 1,100 measured products does not establish prospective performance.
The aldehyde leave-one-component-out regime is a diagnostic, not a licence to widen the qualified domain.

descope.reason: The full six-model, three-regime package was disproportionate to the paper's central claim. The paper is a prospective LNP-discovery result, not a predictive-model benchmarking study. AGILE compared against ridge, lasso, gradient boosting and SVM on one scaffold split and proceeded to synthesis; the Nature Biotechnology LiON precedent leads with prospective biology, not model comparison.
retained: nearest_analogue_product (included only because fingerprints are already computed)
dropped: aldehyde leave-one-component-out as a required deliverable
descope.evaluation: existing component-aware 5-fold cross-validation on the measured 1,100, the same regime already used in the project
descope.purpose_retained: answer only the obvious reviewer question: does the neural oracle add information beyond factorial component identity and molecular similarity
claims_not_supported_and_not_made: the oracle is state of the art
performance generalizes broadly to unseen building blocks
the model beats every plausible predictor
